acceptance: PKCE and normal source login operate without token passthrough or assuming OAuth login can create unrelated vendor sessions.

positive.fixture: authorization-code flow with S256 PKCE against a local identity provider; source-managed sign-in records a grant with no secret; refresh renews

negative.fixture: 16 hostile or buggy server replies mint nothing; stolen code without verifier; mixed-up issuer; unexpected sign-in; OAuth grant never authenticates the source session

security_and_source_permissions: No token passthrough; OAuth never creates a source session; state is single use and bound to the caller.
performance_memory_storage: Token replies capped at 1 MiB; at most 64 pending flows per caller.
